newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazilian gymnast in coma after bus crash.
newsitem.headline: Brazilian gymnast in coma after bus crash.

text.p: A top Brazilian gymnast was in a coma on Friday with severe head injuries she suffered in a bus crash.

Fourteen-year-old Ursula Galera Flores, ranked second among the country's female gymnasts, was in a serious condition with several brain haemorrhages, according to a statement issued by a Sao Paulo hospital.
Flores' trainer, Giorgette Vidor Melo, was also injured in the accident and underwent surgery on her spine.

Six people were killed and 15 injured when a bus and two trucks collided on a busy highway near Sao Paulo on Thursday. Flores and Malo were members of a Rio de Janeiro gymnastics team travelling on the bus.
